mcqs.question: Following the August 26, 2026 rock–ice collapse near the Nepal–China border, approximately how much hydropower capacity was lost in Nepal?
mcqs.explanation: Nepal lost approximately 475 MW of hydropower capacity in the disaster. The tempting figure of 47.5 MW refers to the quantity of relief sent by India, not hydropower capacity.

mcqs.question: According to the economic valuation of the Pichavaram Mangrove Forest, what was the estimated Total Economic Value of its ecosystem services?
mcqs.explanation: The Total Economic Value of the Pichavaram Mangrove Forest was estimated at ₹2,485.38 crore. ₹1,612.40 crore was the combined carbon value, while ₹1,224.63 crore was the value assigned to soil organic carbon.
